dct_creator_sm: University of Alberta Library (University of Alberta).
dct_description_sm: This dataset contains the extracted data from the University of Alberta Library's twitter accounts, including: University of Alberta Libraries (@uofalibrary), University of Alberta Press (@UAlbertaPress), Biblio St. Jean (@bibliosaintjean), and Augustana Library (@AugustanaLib). Each archive contains tweets, likes, lists and moments.  Direct Messages have been removed from the archive. Each archive includes a file named "Your archive.html" for navigating the content and a "README.txt" file which describes the data in more detail.
dct_rights_sm: Works created by the University of Alberta Libraries are dedicated to the public domain, CC0 (https://creativecommons.org/public-domain/cc0/). The rights to any content (e.g., retweets, images, etc.) not created by the UAL belong to their original creators and may have different terms of use.
